reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was $29.99 for 30 servings, which is a dollar a serving when my Nature Made or Double Wood bottle runs 20 to 40 cents, and then zero reviews. The lab QR is nice but I can't buy a brand with no reviews when I read the 1-star ones first.
